name: Plan B MELD matched text reliability exploration
scope: Exploratory reused Validation; no independent-confirmation claim

matching.pool: All 1109 frozen MELD Validation records; no perturbed outcome used
matching.algorithm: Maximum-cardinality 1:1 disjoint correct/error matching within each cell, then minimum total absolute confidence distance via scipy.linear_sum_assignment; stable sample-ID sort before solver
matching.tie: Deterministic scipy solver on ID-sorted FP64 cost matrix; preserve chosen pairs and hash

perturbations.prior_target_candidates: Reuse exact all prior four strings/reviews for overlapping targets, retain FAIL/UNCERTAIN; do not regenerate
perturbations.new_candidates: Single input-only generation plus independent AI semantic QA before inference; all fixed versions retained, no response-based repair
perturbations.other_modalities_and_utterance_features: Bit-exact unchanged; target-only text replacement and entire Dialogue inference

review.package: All previous MELD 480 variants plus four per newly matched target; deduplicate same target/variant; preserve complete context
review.human_review: Two blank independent reviewer sections; PENDING until actual humans review, never fill from AI
review.ai_records: Preserved original AI records and attributed new generation/second-review, separately mapped
review.human_confirmed_scope: Both reviewers PASS for each fixed variant, complete family for both members; unavailable if no human reviews
review.computational_primary_scope: AI-reviewed exploratory complete pairs, never called human-confirmed
review.diagnostic_scope: All complete automatic input-QC pairs; FAIL/UNCERTAIN semantic versions retained separately

features.text_encoder: Exact same frozen MELD best RoBERTa Large and tokenizer in TEXT_repro
features.negative_control: Parent pilot gates: feature atol=rtol=1e-4, probability atol=rtol=1e-4, prediction unchanged

behavior.aggregation: Per family K2; never combine types or drop a failed version

statistics.bootstrap_unit: Dialogue; same 80-cohort-Dialogue draws shared across types/metrics/scopes/calipers
statistics.primary_estimand: Mean within-Dialogue pair difference (error minus correct), then equal weight over eligible Dialogues
statistics.secondary_estimand: Equal weight over eligible matched pairs, with Dialogue cluster resampling
priority_metrics: JS error-correct contrast for each of two families
statistics.intervals: 95% percentile exploratory CIs; also 97.5% Bonferroni intervals for the two priority JS contrasts
statistics.calipers: Primary all frozen pairs; fixed absolute gap<=0.02 and<=0.01 sensitivities, never rematch

minimum_interpretable_support.note: Predeclared descriptive interpretation floor, not formal power proof

statistics.ranking: No fit: pair concordance higher behavior=error, ties0.5; compare against error-score 1-confidence on same pairs, equal-Dialogue aggregation and shared bootstrap
statistics.confounding: Bins approximate continuous confidence; fixed calipers reduce residual imbalance but do not eliminate semantic/class confounding
statistics.incremental_value: Conditional association/ranking only. No fitted confidence+behavior score, no independent/OOF gain, no calibration benefit claim

boundaries: Full-text review package local only; no public upload
